requiredBehaviors.behavior: allow necessary urgent safety action without waiting for root cause complete distribution data or administrative completeness
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Urgent safety action explicitly bypasses root-cause and administrative-completeness waits.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: document the urgent exception and current authority-reporting sequence rather than silently bypassing regulatory obligations
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Urgency produces an explicit sequencing and rationale state while reporting duties remain open.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep unknown distribution and scope facts explicit and trigger continued scope reconciliation
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Unknown scope remains unknown and drives reconciliation rather than invented completion.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: delay an urgent safety action solely until root cause or full device lists are complete
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The safety-bypass rule forbids such delay.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat urgency as eliminating regulatory reporting or documentation duties
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Urgency changes sequence, not the existence of obligations.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent missing distribution facts to complete the FSCA package
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Missing distribution facts stay explicit gaps.
